The button needs onPress, and the draft needs its own state so the list only grows on submit.

```tsx
import { useState } from "react"
import { FlatList, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from "react-native"
import NoteRow from "../components/NoteRow"

export default function HomeScreen() {
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("")

  function addNote() {
    const text = draft.trim()
    if (text.length === 0) return
    setNotes((current) => [...current, text])
    setDraft("")
  }

  return (
    <View>
      <TextInput value={draft} onChangeText={setDraft} placeholder="New note" />
      <TouchableOpacity onPress={addNote}>
        <Text>Add note</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
      <FlatList data={notes} renderItem={({ item }) => <NoteRow text={item} />} keyExtractor={(item) => item} />
    </View>
  )
}
```<|im_end|>
